title: Derived scalar reduction computed by a strict-perfect quotient resolution
statement: For n and the coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], let P be a bounded complex of completed coefficient module sheaves with the finite-free retract package of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-tensor-products]. Suppose α is a quasi-isomorphism from P to the restricted quotient sheaf in degree zero of [lem-weil-pbc-completed-constant-sheaf-reduction]. Then derived scalar extension to the nth quotient followed by restriction is naturally isomorphic to finiteProjectiveTensorRight(P).

proof.text: The ordinary tensor cancellation isomorphism with the target unit identifies scalar extension followed by restriction with tensor by the restricted quotient, naturally in the source module.

For K-flat C, tensor α by C. Its cone is acyclic by K-flatness, hence the localized tensor comparison is invertible. Extract invertibility of the homotopy scalar-extension counit from adicDatumComplexCounit_isIso by cancelling its three invertible comparison factors.

Descend the natural comparison from complexes to homotopy complexes by full faithfulness of the homotopy quotient. The full subcategory of K-flat homotopy objects localizes to the derived category: use the right calculus of fractions and K-flat resolutions. On that subcategory both the tensor augmentation and restricted scalar counit are natural isomorphisms. Compose them and descend the resulting natural isomorphism by full faithfulness of precomposition with this localization.

theorem completedFiniteReductionTensorComparison (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (adicDatumModules T d) ℤ)
    (hb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, j < a ∨ b < j → IsZero (P.X j))
    (p : SheafOfModules.StrictPerfectCoefficientPackageOnSite
      ((adicLisseForget T).obj (adicDatumRing T d)) P)
    (α : P ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      (CompletedConstantReduction.residue T d.ideal n))
    (hα : QuasiIso α) :
    Nonempty (adicDatumReductionUnderlying T d n ≅
      finiteProjectiveTensorRight T d P hb p)
